Around the docks

Approach, stop, and departure at every dock. Visits start together at the beginning of their recorded window.
Same scale throughout: circle = 50m radius. Cross = station pin; north is up. Gold tiles end when a rest break begins.

Orange: moving · Purple: estimated stopped period or completed visit · Red: final position. Gold: rest stop, showing approach only; break time is omitted and docking duration is unmeasured. GPS gaps over 2 seconds are left disconnected.
